dedupe_keys.name: north american virtual climate library of surface temperature

description: The virtual climate library is a Figshare collection of observed and simulated North American surface temperatures for the late twentieth and early twenty-first centuries. Its own collection page lists forty-five child items, including the original NARR temperature source, daily minimum-temperature realizations and code used to construct the empirical model. A modeller can sample alternative temperature histories to test heat-sensitive building, energy or water simulations instead of relying on one deterministic weather sequence. These are generated climate realizations, so the underlying NARR source and the model assumptions matter when interpreting local extremes. The collection title specifies 1979 to 2005, while the Scientific Data article title extends to 2015; users should verify the years of each child item before choosing a series. All 45 member item(s) state CC0 in the Figshare article API; the collection DataCite registration says CC BY 4.0. I checked the article and repository metadata, but did not inspect the NetCDF files or run the code.
